w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound gets un-written.) (Farid lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They argued over names for 5 beasts — 5 words, 5 debates: "Ugly-Eyes" (2), "Big Loud" (2), "Old Gavel" (2), "Big-Eyes" (2), "Big Ugly" (2).

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Callback is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (24/14/6), with 5 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 9 · Craft 8 · Talk 6 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Lucas Brown ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Lemma returns from the wilds hurt (health 6/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Maiko returns from the wilds hurt (health 3/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,000 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
